title: NZ MBIE Determination 2026/018 (comparative): importance level for seismic strengthening of an existing building
jurisdiction: New Zealand (Building Act 2004); Nelson City Council; comparative only, not Alberta
code_edition: NZ Building Code (Schedule 1, Building Regulations 1992) as cited; B1/VM1 first edition, amendment 21 as cited; AS/NZS 1170.0 referenced

facts.text: The authority granted building consent BC250300 for seismic strengthening of an existing commercial building in central Nelson.
The building has been considered as Importance Level 2 (IL2) in the consent.
The building was first constructed in 1974 as a two-storey commercial building with a retail store of about 1,700 m2 and a public arcade.
Table 3.1 sets out consequences of failure and Table 3.2 sets out importance levels for building types.
Verification Method B1/VM1 (first edition, amendment 21) is cited.
